subject: Kickoff recap + compact showcase windows
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@pilotai.com>, Procurement Team <procure@pilotai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff recap + compact showcase windows

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal from your side: validate a short proof-of-concept for support-ticket summarization and a lightweight embeddings-powered search over KB articles.
- Success criteria: < 1s median query latency for search, summaries that match your template 80% of the time in our eval set.
- Risks flagged on the call: SSO timeline (Okta), and data residency for some project metadata.

We'd like to run a 30-minute compact showcase with your product and infra owners to walk through: runtime latency profile, an integration checklist, and a short Q&A on SSO/data handling. Can you confirm which of these stakeholder roles will join?

Because schedules were tight on your side, proposing three 30-minute windows next week — pick 1 (all times PT):
  1) Tue 2026-12-08 09:30–10:00
  2) Wed 2026-12-09 13:00–13:30
  3) Thu 2026-12-10 11:00–11:30

If none work, tell me two narrow ranges and we’ll match. I attached a one-pager (Compact-showcase-onepager.pdf) with the agenda and pre-call asks.

Next steps we’ll own: build a short runbook for the call and surface any pre-demo infra questions.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Compact-showcase-onepager.pdf (pdf)]

> Can you confirm which of these stakeholder roles will join?
Samir: I’ll bring myself (Head of Product), Alyssa (Infra lead, alyssa@pilotai.com) and Tom from Security (tom.s@pilotai.com) — procurement is looped for scheduling only.

> Windows proposed
Prefer Wed 2026-12-09 13:00–13:30 PT but we have a conflict with our weekly all-hands; is there any flexibility +/- 30 mins? If not, the Thu 11:00 slot might work for Alyssa.

Also: Can you share the integration checklist you mentioned? Tom wants to pre-scan allowed endpoints and expected network flows.

Samir

On Wed, Dec 02, 2026 at 10:42 AM Samir Patel <samir@pilotai.com> wrote:
> Prefer Wed 2026-12-09 13:00–13:30 PT but we have a conflict with our weekly all-hands; is there any flexibility +/- 30 mins?

Thanks — yes, we can shift a bit. Updated short list (all PT) — please pick the best-fit and I’ll send the calendar invite:
  • Wed 2026-12-09 12:30–13:00 (earlier by 30m)
  • Wed 2026-12-09 13:00–13:30 (original)
  • Thu 2026-12-10 11:00–11:30

For Tom: attaching the integration checklist and a short network-flows summary. The checklist lists required ports, sample manifest for K8s deployment, and a minimal reverse-proxy approach for private deployments.

We’ll aim to keep the session tight — 10m context, 10m demo (latency + embeddings search), 10m Q&A. If it helps, Priyom can run the demo with a small synthetic dataset first to illustrate tail latency.

I attached: PilotAI-integration-checklist.xlsx and Compact-showcase-onepager.pdf again.

— Grace
